**Chapter 11: Mineral Resources: Fossils**

**Section 11.01: Carbon Numbers, Names, and Formula of Alkanes**

**Table 11.01: Carbon Numbers, Names, and Formula of Alkanes**

| Carbon Number of Alkane | Name of Alkane | Formula of Alkane |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Methane | CH4 |
| 2 | Ethane | CH3-CH3 |
| 3 | Propane | CH3-CH2-CH3 |
| 4 | Butane | CH3-CH2-CH2-CH3 |
| 5 | Pentane | CH3-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3 |
| 6 | Hexane | CH3-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3 |
| 7 | Heptane | CH3-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3 |
| 8 | Octane | CH3-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3 |
| 9 | Nonane | CH3-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3 |
| 10 | Decane | CH3-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3 |

**Note:** The table lists the carbon numbers, names, and formulas of alkanes, which are hydrocarbons with only single bonds between carbon atoms. The names of the alkanes are derived from the number of carbon atoms in the molecule, and the formulas are written in the format CHn, where n is the number of carbon atoms.
